evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The owned/rented contrast appeals to self-origination — intelligence that is yours versus borrowed — placing autonomy as the value the text carries.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Framing perspective as a kept asset appeals to both self-origination (your own perspective) and achievement/standing (the asset you retain and build).

mints.name: OwnershipAsValueAxis
mints.title: owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence
mints.frame: Is the expression appealing to ownership — what you keep versus what you rent — as the good at stake?
